The cyclist is crossing the ego vehicle's path from the left (starting at y=-5.0m) with a lateral velocity of 3.3 m/s. Given the ego vehicle's initial speed of 50 kph (~13.9 m/s) and the cyclist's position at x=18.8m, the time to reach the conflict point is approximately 1.35 seconds. The cyclist will move from y=-5.0m to approximately y=0.55m during this time, placing them directly in the ego vehicle's lane (drivable range y=[-1.75, 5.25]). To avoid a collision, the ego vehicle must decelerate significantly. Action A2 typically represents a moderate to strong deceleration or braking maneuver, which is the appropriate response to yield to a crossing vulnerable road user.
